reply:
**Status: Settlement prepared for human approval**

The claims system shows that the settlement was staged and is pending human approval. Nothing has been paid.

**Facts recorded**
- Claim reference: final-CLM-07. Policy VER-1001, insured and driver Claire Martin, Peugeot 208 (2021).
- Coverage claimed: C3 glass breakage, which is listed in the Policy Schedule.
- Incident on 2026-10-09, reported on 2026-10-10 (1 day later).
- A stone thrown up by a truck on the motorway cracked the windscreen. The truck driver is not named.
- Repair quote: €480. Attached: damage_photos.zip and repair_quote.pdf. I could not open the attachments.
- No possible exclusion is indicated by the email.

**Reasoning**
- **Coverage:** C3 covers windscreen and side-window glass, and the deductible for it is €50 (<cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1" name="Contract"/>). The claim is for the insured's own car, so C1 and C2 do not apply.
- **Reporting:** A claim must be reported within 5 days of the incident (Article 4.1). It was reported 1 day after, so it is on time (<cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2"/>).
- **Exclusions:** None of the Article 3 exclusions appears to apply (<cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2"/>).
- **Third party:** The stone came from an unidentified truck. The insured did not cause the damage, so no liability question arises.
- **Referral:** The claim is not referred to a handler, because it is on time, shows no possible exclusion, and is under a covered coverage (Article 7) (<cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3"/>).
- **Documents:** The system recorded the required documents (photos and repair quote) as received. I did not verify the full list in Article 4.3.

**Amounts**
- Deductible: €50 (Article 2).
- Payout: €430, which is €480 less the €50 deductible (Article 6.2).
- Assessor required: No.
- Payment status: pending human approval.

**Draft message to the customer**

> Dear Ms Martin,
>
> Thank you for reporting the windscreen damage from 9 October 2026 under policy VER-1001. We have received your photos and repair quote, and your claim has been passed to our claims team for review. A claims handler will confirm the final decision with you. If you have any questions in the meantime, please contact us.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims
